# Nexus Game Launcher v2.8.0

This feature release expands Nexus's experimental in-game Modal Overlay, adds independent concurrent game sessions, and improves restart-aware process monitoring. It also includes library, artwork, interface, and save-backup improvements committed since v2.7.6.

## Redesigned in-game Modal Overlay

- Four distinct dashboard designs: **Dockline**, **Corner Pulse**, **Side Rail**, and **Command Strip**. Command Strip separates information and actions into two rows.
- Four screen corners, Full / Medium / Mini Display modes, and independent Small / Large window sizes (560 x 338 and 728 x 439 render frames).
- Redesigned Modal Overlay settings with a live preview, grouped appearance options, and launcher theme colors.
- Optional Esc and controller Start quick toggles, configurable keyboard shortcuts, and separate keyboard/controller navigation controls. Quick Esc preserves the game's own Escape input.
- Optional automatic pause/resume of the Nexus session timer when opening/closing the overlay, with safeguards for manually paused sessions.
- Foreground-aware keyboard shortcut routing: the same configured shortcut can be used with multiple running games without reserving it globally for the first overlay helper.

## Independent game sessions

- Run multiple distinct games concurrently, with independent session identities, elapsed timers, Play/Stop controls, and Pause/Resume state.
- Opening another game's details page no longer displays or modifies the previous game's active session.
- Closing one game leaves the other games and their overlays running. Stale or duplicate session events cannot finalize the same session twice or overwrite a newer session.

## Faster, restart-aware game exit

- Explicit Stop uses a faster verification path after a successful, validated stop request.
- Eligible clean exits use a balanced restart guard of approximately four seconds; ambiguous exits and games requiring extra protection retain a longer guard.
- A verified replacement process detected within the protection window continues the same play session and timer rather than creating a separate session.
- Failed process probes are not treated as proof of exit; exit-confirmation time is excluded from the recorded completed session.
- In local Windows tests with Homura Hime and Hollow Knight Silksong, eligible natural-exit confirmation fell from approximately 13 seconds to approximately 4 seconds. Actual timings vary with the game, process-probe availability, and backup settings.

A delayed restart outside the applicable protection window may still be recorded as a separate session. The extended restart guard can be selected for known restart-sensitive games using `NEXUS_RESTART_GUARD_GAME_IDS` (comma-separated game IDs). Restart-sensitive profiles learned during a Nexus run are not permanent across launcher restarts.

## Library, artwork, and save improvements since v2.7.6

- Responsive two-column Add/Edit Game dialog, Favorites toolbar improvements, and a more organized Settings interface.
- SteamGridDB artwork identity recovery, safer title/year matching and retention of existing valid artwork, plus Steam PICS-related asset improvements.
- Correct Recently Added ordering based on saved library insertion order.
- Save discovery and bounded deep-scan safety improvements, backup UI polish, and dependency maintenance.

The existing Steam PICS fallback remains optional and dependent on verified Steam identity and helper availability; its packaged runtime has not been independently verified.

## Experimental feature warning

> **The in-game Modal Overlay remains experimental, Windows-only, and disabled by default.** Use it only with supported offline games without anti-cheat. Compatibility depends on the game, Windows architecture, graphics API, and display mode. Direct3D 11, Direct3D 9, and OpenGL are experimental supported backends; Direct3D 12 remains incomplete/disabled under existing safety restrictions, Vulkan is unverified, and the Windows ARM64 overlay runtime is unsupported.

Pause / Resume Timer changes Nexus playtime accounting, not the game's own pause state. Resume Game closes the overlay; it does not unpause the game itself. FPS remains `N/A` unless verified data is available. A successful build does not guarantee compatibility with every game.

## Installation and updating

Nexus compares its installed application version with the published GitHub Release tag. Once v2.8.0 is published, an older v2.7.6 installation can detect it through **Check for Updates**. Use the Windows NSIS installer for Windows, the matching AppImage for Linux, or the universal DMG for macOS. The existing Windows packaging workflow rebuilds the native x64/x86 overlay components and standalone helper outside `app.asar`, with build and resource verification gates before publication.

The above feature behavior has been tested locally in development builds and regression simulations. Installed-build compatibility and platform artifacts must pass the release workflow and should be tested separately. Report game-specific issues with graphics API and diagnostic information, without private game data.
